entries.title: Luke 15:1
segments: Now all the publicans and sinners were drawing near unto him to hear him.

entries.title: Luke 15:2
segments: And both the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

entries.title: Luke 15:3
segments: And he spake unto them this parable, saying,

entries.title: Luke 15:4
segments: What man of you, having a hundred sheep, and having lost one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

entries.title: Luke 15:5
segments: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

entries.title: Luke 15:6
segments: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and his neighbors, saying unto them, Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost.

entries.title: Luke 15:7
segments: I say unto you, that even so there shall be joy in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, [more] than over ninety and nine righteous persons, who need no repentance.

entries.title: Luke 15:8
segments: Or what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a lamp, and sweep the house, and seek diligently until she find it?

entries.title: Luke 15:9
segments: And when she hath found it, she calleth together her friends and neighbors, saying, Rejoice with me, for I have found the piece which I had lost.

entries.title: Luke 15:10
segments: Even so, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

entries.title: Luke 15:11
segments: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

entries.title: Luke 15:12
segments: and the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of [thy] substance that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

entries.title: Luke 15:13
segments: And not many days after, the younger son gathered all together and took his journey into a far country; and there he wasted his substance with riotous living.

entries.title: Luke 15:14
segments: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that country; and he began to be in want.

entries.title: Luke 15:15
segments: And he went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

entries.title: Luke 15:16
segments: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

entries.title: Luke 15:17
segments: But when he came to himself he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish here with hunger!

entries.title: Luke 15:18
segments: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight:

entries.title: Luke 15:19
segments: I am no more worthy to be called your son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

entries.title: Luke 15:20
segments: And he arose, and came to his father. But while he was yet afar off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

entries.title: Luke 15:21
segments: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight: I am no more worthy to be called thy son.

entries.title: Luke 15:22
segments: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth quickly the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

entries.title: Luke 15:23
segments: and bring the fatted calf, [and] kill it, and let us eat, and make merry:

entries.title: Luke 15:24
segments: for this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

entries.title: Luke 15:25
segments: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard music and dancing.

entries.title: Luke 15:26
segments: And he called to him one of the servants, and inquired what these things might be.

entries.title: Luke 15:27
segments: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

entries.title: Luke 15:28
segments: But he was angry, and would not go in: and his father came out, and entreated him.

entries.title: Luke 15:29
segments: But he answered and said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, and I never transgressed a commandment of thine; and [yet] thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

entries.title: Luke 15:30
segments: but when this thy son came, who hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou killedst for him the fatted calf.

entries.title: Luke 15:31
segments: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that is mine is thine.

entries.title: Luke 15:32
segments: But it was meet to make merry and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive [again]; and [was] lost, and is found.
